    {

    },
    {
      "name": "priority_avg_duration",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Group-mean duration per priority; a genuine analytical aggregate directly relevant to explaining variance by priority. Derived from in-table values."
    },
    {
      "name": "category_avg_duration",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Group-mean duration per category; useful for attributing variance to category. Grounded in derived values."
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_vs_priority_avg",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Deviation of a ticket's duration from its priority mean directly answers 'why durations vary'. Consistent arithmetic with the two source columns."
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_vs_category_avg",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Deviation from category mean; a strong residual-style axis for explaining variance. Values check out arithmetically."
    },
    {
      "name": "assignee_avg_duration",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Mean duration per assignee, derived from assigned_to and duration. Useful to test whether assignee explains variation."
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_vs_assignee_avg",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Deviation from assignee mean; directly relevant residual axis. Arithmetic consistent with the underlying columns."
    },
    {
      "name": "has_round_duration",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.05,
      "source_groundedness": 0.9,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Constant 0 across all 500 rows, providing zero analytical leverage for explaining duration variance. Grounded but useless."
    }
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.76,
  "source_groundedness": 0.88,
  "rationale": "The added columns form a coherent, highly relevant set for the query 'why do durations vary': the target (resolution_hours), grouping dimensions (priority, category flags, assignee) and their group means, plus residual deviation columns that directly decompose variance. Values in the row_evidence_samples are arithmetically and categorically consistent with the source text and timestamps, so groundedness is strong. Weaknesses: has_round_duration is a dead constant with no value, and duration_category is largely a restatement of the target; several is_* flags and the paired avg/deviation columns are somewhat redundant among themselves. Per scope rule, no penalty for any missing columns."
}
